name: Competitor Watch & Alert
description: Researches what your top competitors did this week, and only bothers you with a recommendation if something is actually worth reacting to. Pauses for your approval before saving the final recommendation.
author: CodeCraft

config.goal: Research what our top 3 competitors launched or announced this week

config.question: Does this research mention something concerning or worth reacting to for our business? {{node_2.output}}

config.goal: Given this: {{node_2.output}}, draft a recommended response as our co-founder would

config.label: Review the recommended response before saving it

name: Lead Research & Outreach Loop
description: Finds a handful of leads, then drafts a personalized outreach email for each one individually. Every single email waits for your approval on the Tasks page before it can send - nothing goes out automatically.
author: CodeCraft

config.goal: Find 3 potential leads for [describe your product or service], one per line
